```{r setup}
# install.packages("tidytext")
# install.packages("gutenbergr)

library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(gutenbergr)
```

```{r import}
# Relativity: The Special and General Theory by Albert Einstein
# Source: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/30155
# Download the text with the Project Gutenberg header and footer removed
df_text <- gutenberg_download(
  30155,
  mirror = "https://mirrors.xmission.com/gutenberg"
) |> 
  mutate(line = row_number())

df_text
```

```{r tidy-text}
# Split the text into words and keep the original line numbers
# unnest_tokens() also makes words lowercase and removes punctuation
df_tidy <- df_text |>
  unnest_tokens(word, text)

df_tidy

# Count the rows in the tidy data frame
nrow(df_tidy)
```
